name: EPSY 5625
title: Mental Disorders in Counseling Practice: Diagnosis and Treatment
description: Designed to provide students pursuing counseling licensure (LPC) an understanding of abnormal psychological behavior in children and adults. Topics covered in the course include, diagnostic and classification systems of mental disorders, such as depressive disorders, anxiety, OCD, trauma, personality disorders, and eating disorders to highlight a few that are discussed. In addition to examining diagnostic criteria and processes, students will learn how to develop culturally appropriate treatment plans for different mental disorders.
requirement_description: Instructor consent required. Open only to students in the LPC Certificate program.
